jobs.prompt:
Goal g-33a7a4ae, D-fix batch 22d (logging-only visibility round). Read docs/state/silent-failures.md methodology (top) and the sections for the files below. Edit ONLY: tools/handoff-docs.mjs, tools/managers/replay.mjs, tools/pins.mjs. Visibility only: do NOT change control flow, return values, fallbacks, throws, or exports. No refactors or reformatting.

Line numbers below are CURRENT (verified against origin/main). For each listed catch, bind the error and do exactly what the line says:
- SILENT-<CODE>: stay silent when error?.code === '<CODE>' (or the named class, e.g. SyntaxError); console.error anything else. Keep the same fallback value.
- LOG-ALWAYS: console.error unconditionally, include the path/id named, keep the same fallback value.
- For `.catch(() => null)` / `.catch(() => '')` forms, keep returning the same value from inside the new handler.
- A close/cleanup inside an error path that rethrows: log the cleanup error with a DIFFERENT binding name; the original error must still be rethrown unchanged.

### tools/handoff-docs.mjs
Logger prefix: console.error('[tools/handoff-docs.mjs] <short context>:', error?.message ?? error)
- Line 137 `try { await res.body?.cancel(); } catch { /* nothing to cancel */ }`: an already-closed/locked stream throws TypeError or error?.code === 'ERR_INVALID_STATE'; stay silent for those, log others.
- Line 146 `try { await reader.cancel(); } catch { /* already closed */ }`: same rule as line 137.
- Line 188 `try { out.push({ name, text: await fs.readFile(path.join(dir, name), 'utf8') }); } catch { /* not written yet */ }`: SILENT-ENOENT; log others with name.

### tools/managers/replay.mjs
Logger prefix: console.error('[tools/managers/replay.mjs] <short context>:', error?.message ?? error)
- Line 74 `const st = await fs.lstat(dir).catch(() => null);`: SILENT-ENOENT; log others with dir; keep null (the explicit throw on the next line stays).
- Line 109 `const st = await fs.lstat(resolved).catch(() => null);`: SILENT-ENOENT; log others with resolved; keep null.
- Line 470 `await fs.rm(workspaceRoot, { recursive: true, force: true }).catch(() => {});` in finally: LOG-ALWAYS with workspaceRoot (force means ENOENT never throws; any failure leaks a temp workspace).

### tools/pins.mjs
Logger prefix: console.error('[tools/pins.mjs] <short context>:', error?.message ?? error)
- Line 91 `const real = await fs.realpath(needle).catch(() => null);`: SILENT-ENOENT; log others with needle; keep null.
- Line 133 `await fs.rm(tmp, { recursive: true, force: true }).catch(() => {});` in finally: LOG-ALWAYS with tmp (leaked temp dir).
- Line 171 `} catch { /* listing still shows the pointer version */ }` around versionDirFor + runnerVersionAtRoot: LOG-ALWAYS with p.pinnedAt (the listing falls back silently today); runnerVersion stays null.

Do NOT touch any other catch. FORBIDDEN shortcut patterns (rejected in review): `catch (e) { e; }`, `.catch((_e) => ...)` never logged, `void error`, any binding not used in a real check or console.error.

Then grep tests/ for each file's basename and run those tests with: node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test <files>; confirm green. Final summary: one line per flagged line.
